| --- | ------- |
| ❌  | Explain how this PR relates to the other open PR for the issue (#33086): the description only says "Related issue: #31985" and never mentions it, and the comment doesn't name it either |
| ❌  | Work through the continuing-unfinished-work guidelines: nothing shows the earlier attempt (#33086) was reviewed or credited |
| ⚠️  | Precise before/after screenshots: the description has them, but there are 4 "before" images and only 2 "after" images, so they don't clearly pair up |
| ℹ️  | The code changes since the feedback are unknown (head commit not found), so the author's claim of an update can't be checked against a push |
| ℹ️  | The self-review checklist still has several unchecked items, including the AI use policy |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to put the #33086 comparison in the PR description and to pair up the screenshots.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update, @PrinceXDev! I don't see the explanation of how this relates to #33086 in the PR description yet, so please add it, following the [guidelines on continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html). Please also make the before/after screenshots [precise pairs](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
